newsitem.title: USA: API says U.S. crude stocks fell in week.
newsitem.headline: API says U.S. crude stocks fell in week.

text.p: U.S. crude oil stocks held in primary storage fell 5.43 million barrels in the week ended July 11 to 317.23 million barrels from 322.66 million barrels the previous week, the American Petroleum Institute said Tuesday.
API said that crude stocks excluding PADD 5 (Petroleum Administration for Defense District) fell 2.34 million barrels in the week to 257.45 million barrels.
Distillate stocks rose 5.46 million barrels to 121.39 million barrels from 115.93 million barrels the prior week.
API said PADD 1 distillate stocks rose 3.19 million barrels to 44.46 million barrels.
It said gasoline production rose 31,000 barrels per day in the week to 8.00 million bpd from 7.97 million bpd in the prior week.
Gasoline stocks fell 3.50 million barrels in the week to 200.60 million barrels from 204.10 million.
Percent of stocks capacity rose to 96.8 percent from 95.6 percent the prior week.
API said reformulated gasoline stocks (RFG) fell 1.87 million barrels to 41.29 million barrels from 43.15 million barrels the previous week.
API also said refinery operating rate excluding PADD 5 rose to 101.0 percent in the week from 99.8 percent the previous week.
API said crude runs to processing units rose to 14.91 million barrels per day from 14.76 million the previous week.
Residual fuel stocks in the latest week fell to 39.14 million barrels from 40.41 million in the previous week.
Crude oil imports fell to 7.68 million barrels per day from 8.96 million, API said.
